What is the ratio of the average number of female athletes who participated from England over all the years together to the average number of female athletes who participated from France over all the years together?
solution:
**Calculation:**

Average number of female athletes from England = (480 + 420 + 130 + 250)/4

⇒ 1280/4 = 320

Average number of female athletes from France = (280 + 120 + 160 + 600)/4

⇒ 1160/4 = 290

Required ratio = 320 : 290

⇒ 32 : 29 

**∴ The correct option is 4.**
